method: Hand review of distinct question, deliverable, funnel stage, source and link direction; not inferred from shingle score. Shared generic CTA/disclaimer/template language alone is not a merge reason.

evidence: agency: responsibility table separates supplier deliverables and user responsibilities.
cloud: work-location/check-device/evaluation-sheet concern device, license and handover.
trial: before-registration/first-test/record concern an evaluation plan.
clusters.ownedQueries: Home: product buying. Catalog: module selection. Agency guide: solution category. Cloud guide: deployment requirements. Trial guide: evaluation plan.
clusters.risk: Generic إدارة حسابات/service/software phrases can overlap; no agency commercial landing page is justified.

evidence: naming-rule/prepare-fields: specific account name and field review.
support-note/redact/after-reply: reproducible support report, secrets redaction, repeat test.
one-row/state-and-proof/receiving-check: task status and handover evidence.
security platform: session presets and intervals, not an account-recovery guarantee.
clusters.ownedQueries: accounts: product module. naming: clear account labels. support: error report. handover: work log. security: configuration limits.
clusters.risk: Do not make all pages target broad إدارة حسابات or حل مشكلة الحساب. Each has a different expected answer.

evidence: contact-list: source/normalize/deduplicate/approve concern input eligibility.
WhatsApp: recipient/message/attachment/check-result concern a consented single message.
SMTP: provider-sheet/credentials/delivery concern server auth, recipient mailbox and reply.
clusters.risk: Common preparation words do not justify merging; no official WhatsApp integration or guaranteed deliverability inferred.

evidence: Platform: unit entry points, requirements, evidence limits.
Guide fields/limit explain a visible data-task form and distinguish publishing.
clusters.risk: Do not give guide ownership of all Facebook program queries or call a data screenshot a publishing walkthrough.

evidence: Instagram content-pack/match-function: approved text/image and a matching function.
TikTok master/rights: full video, timecoded issue and source audio rights.
Pinterest theme/assets/description: board idea, image/destination consistency, distinct useful captions.
Threads destination/copy/function: adapting meaning and identity for a separate destination.
clusters.risk: These are generic preparation guides with moderate commercial relevance. They are not proven operating tutorials; adding more generic lookalikes without query data would dilute usefulness.

evidence: Two current module menus differ.
Guide destination/permissions distinguishes channel/group and account role.
Guide product explicitly refuses to equate Sky Pro module name with official Telegram subscription.
clusters.risk: Unit name ambiguity is real. Premium official membership must never be claimed as included.

evidence: LinkedIn reason/identity/request: professional message with a genuine prior request example.
X classify/policy/result: distinguish search/post/message and confirm execution route.
Reddit read/contribution/no-repeat: community-specific contributions and no mass promotion.
clusters.risk: These are not equivalent requests. Relevant APIs/authorized methods remain product evidence gaps, not keyword opportunities to overclaim.

evidence: Platform states menu-only evidence and asks for proof of search/export.
Guide purpose/access/proof/quality adds source, required fields, attribution/storage and acceptance criteria.
clusters.risk: Closest commercial-investigation pair; both ask for proof. Keep guide because of independent evaluation detail; do not assert absence of cannibalization. If same queries land on both and answers converge after true product proof, prefer platform as commercial owner and a narrower source/evaluation guide.

evidence: Platform is brief module-status/availability disclosure.
Guide market/availability/demo/decision provides a country-specific demo request template and a complete input-to-result acceptance sheet.
clusters.risk: Closest status/demonstration overlap; no independent screen or function result exists. Only measured page/query evidence and loss of unique answer would justify later merge.

evidence: Snapchat availability/lock requirements differ from Auto Point X/Instagram task menu.
No article targets the same specific module.
clusters.risk: Do not turn vague function labels into ready-made growth, account-unlock or result claims. Their direct commercial relevance is evidence-limited.

mergeThreshold: Review an overlap when authorized GSC shows sustained query/page switching or mismatched landing intent with enough observations. First improve intent boundaries/links and verify product proof. Merge only when two pages answer substantially the same primary task and one adds no unique useful answer; preserve redirects and internal links if an approved merge is ever implemented.
timeWindow: No arbitrary ranking or conversion success is inferred from two days after publication. Choose a window consistent with actual indexation and query volume.
